category_title: Kindergarten students involved in physical conflict over classroom space
scenario_title: Physical conflict over seating during transition to morning meeting
minimal_context: Aiden and Ariel are transitioning to the morning meeting rug at the start of the school day.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Aiden, I saw you walk up and push Ariel. What is going on?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Aiden makes eye contact) I want him to move. That’s my spot.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Can you use your words to ask him that, to ask him to move somewhere different?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Aiden looks to the floor, knotting his fingers and kicking the ground) Can you move to another spot? That’s my spot. (Ariel kicks the ground as well and tucks both hands beneath his waistband.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Did it bother you, Ariel, that Aiden touched you? Did it bother you when he pushed you instead of using words?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Ariel stares, expressionless. He continues staring, and eventually whispers) I’m sorry that you bothered me.

task.content: Transitioning from free play (Legos, drawing) to the morning meeting rug for the start of the school day.
task.learning_goal: Engaging in teacher-directed conflict resolution on the morning meeting rug.

context.social_setting: While other kids take their seats

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When Aiden wants Ariel to move from a specific spot on the rug.
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Aiden walks up to Ariel and shoves him. Ariel stares, and Aiden shoves him again.
related_quotes: I want him to move. That’s my spot.

behavior_patterns.condition: When prompted by the teacher to 'use your words' to ask to move.
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Aiden looks to the floor, knotting his fingers, kicks the ground, and says softly: 'Can you move to another spot? That’s my spot.' Ariel kicks the ground as well and tucks both hands beneath his waistband.
related_quotes: Can you move to another spot? That’s my spot.

behavior_patterns.condition: When asked repeatedly if being pushed bothered him.
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Ariel stares, expressionless, continues staring, and eventually whispers a confused apology.
related_quotes: I’m sorry that you bothered me.
